# Summarix

> Self-hosted Telegram channel summarizer: a Telegram bot, a Claude Code plugin and an MCP server that summarize the Telegram channels you follow with AI - private channels included - into one short digest with a link to every post.

Key facts:

- Reads channels through the user's own Telegram account (Telethon), so private channels and albums work; the account is used read-only.
- The bot sends one digest a day (plus /digest on demand): 2-6 bullets per channel, the day's top 3 highlights first; the model cites post numbers only and the bot turns them into links, so links cannot be invented.
- 13 digest styles plus a custom prompt; summaries in Russian, English, Spanish, French and Kazakh; groups built from Telegram folders (t.me/addlist links); /search across your channels and /find for live new channels.
- Digest by channel or by topic: in the topic layout the same story from several channels becomes one point linked to every source, and the code rejects a grouping that drops a cited fact or adds a post. A word filter (/mute) keeps posts with chosen words out. Each digest with news can also be saved as Markdown (DIGEST_EXPORT_DIR), e.g. into an Obsidian vault.
- Ready Docker image: ghcr.io/andreysukhanov/summarix-telegram (amd64, arm64). Without Docker: `pipx install summarix-telegram` gives the commands summarix-bot, summarix-login, tgdigest and summarix-mcp; SUMMARIX_HOME is the folder with .env and data/.
- Images in posts are captioned by a vision model with a per-run cost cap; read marks move only after delivery, so nothing is lost on failure.
- Works with any OpenAI-compatible API (OpenAI, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Qwen or a local model). The Claude Code skill and the MCP server need no model key: the client's model writes the digest.
- MCP server tools: fetch_posts, read_part, search_posts, find_channels, list_channels, add_channels, remove_channels, list_styles.
- Optional mod `summarix-panel` (Claude Code 2.1.287+, `/plugin install summarix-panel@summarix-telegram`): the digest in a pane beside the chat, links kept, the last 10 digests paged across sessions, a new digest for 24 h / 3 days / a week in one press.
- Python 3.13, aiogram 3, Telethon, SQLite, Docker; 140 offline tests; Source-Available license.
